relatedSourceMoves.claimSummary: Without a reality governing humanity, ethical standards reduce to whatever humans in charge decide.
relatedSourceMoves.reasonSummary: Sharpton asks who can decide wickedness and rightness if humans are the highest authority and answers that morality would then be wholly up to us.
